provenance.galleryTitle: Eight fresh sounds — what gets lost?
galleryIntro: Eight new-to-this-listening-study tagged sounds. Existing synth-trained experts and their refinements are compared with original Bfxr.

All eight files occur in the historical original-Bfxr real-audio training list. They are external inputs for the newer synthetic-trained experts, but not an unseen Bfxr test. Source families can overlap.

Choose the closest, then how close it feels. For imperfect matches, one optional question asks the biggest mismatch while the sounds remain available. Skip it with S. Take the optional break after five.
provenance.scope: New to retained listening feedback, with prior exact source and audition PCM excluded. All eight overlap historical original-Bfxr training. Not a family-disjoint test. Existing frozen inverses/scorers; no retraining or quality-improvement claim.
provenance.selectionPolicy: Soft winner, preference winner, original Bfxr; deduplicate exact PCM then highest-ranked distinct preference alternative if fewer than three. All eight references, no score-based dropping.

diagnosticQuestion.storage: Scoped target note with exact candidate IDs; unchanged schema3
diagnosticQuestion.reloadPolicy: Completed judgments remain saved even if the optional question was left unanswered.

publicationBindings.backendHashTiming: Frozen before inference and rechecked at publication.
